cases.description: A content filter changes the body of a text/html response.
A content filter can set a response header on a text/html response.
A content filter keeps the status of the response.
A content filter does not change the body of a response that is not text/html.
A filter body that does not define contentFilter gives a 500 response.
A filter rule changes a static text/html page.
A filter rule does not change a static file that is not text/html.
